description: skill-router: index installed skills at session start, route every prompt, learn from skill usage

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$R/scripts/hooks/session-start.js"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$R/scripts/hooks/prompt.js"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$R/scripts/hooks/skill-used.js"
